content:
This app makes $1M/mo
and the onboarding is the whole reason

Steal the playbook for your app 👇

→ Make them bond before they commit
You hatch a bird and name it first
You're not a user, you're a parent

→ Ask for the account after the hook
Only once you're already attached

→ Let the product ask, not the app
The pet asks for notifications, not a popup

→ Map them, then hand a "personal plan"
So the paywall feels earned, not random

→ Show the price only when they're invested
7-day trial, 79,99€ slashed to 39,99€
"expires when you exit this screen"

Build the attachment first
the payment feels obvious after
